method: 3D SIMP topology optimization (parts/picogk-catalog/bionic/topopt.py), then PicoGK smoothing and exact functional features
basis_note: SAFETY CRITICAL powertrain mount: load-path concept only. Interfaces and loads are NOT measured. The domain is the vendor 600 x 50 x 50 mm envelope (a logistics value, read as a maximum); end-boss positions and the hypothetical 13 mm bores come from the previous concept (EngineCarrier.cs); the engine-bracket pad is the previous 130 x 40 mm seat. Loads derive from the one named engine weighing in evidence/load-cases.md (about 195 kg, 993 biturbo complete without gearbox), an ASSUMED 50 % share on this carrier and ASSUMED acceleration factors; load-cases.md itself leaves the share and the factors open. No structural claim; to be recomputed once interfaces, share, factors and material are known.
